name: en_free_shipping_contexts
description: Free-shipping thresholds in USD: a real contradiction (50 vs 75 for the same orders) next to a rule for another scope (international orders) that must not be flagged. A promo code input without its failure path.
requirements:
REQ-1: Orders over 50 USD get free standard shipping.
REQ-2: International orders over 100 USD get free standard shipping.
REQ-3: Orders over $75 get free standard shipping.
REQ-4: The cart page shows the shipping cost before payment.
REQ-5: The user enters a promo code at checkout.

issues.note: free shipping from 50 or from 75 USD
what the user sees after the code is applied

must_not_ask.note: the cart page only displays a value

rule.contradiction.REQ-1+REQ-3.value: REQ-3: Orders over $75 get free standard shipping.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-5.value: An invalid or expired code shows an error under the field and the total does not change.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-5.value: The discount is shown as a separate line and the order total is reduced.

questions.question: Which free-shipping threshold is correct: 50 USD or 75 USD?
Does the international threshold of 100 USD include taxes?
questions.reason: The boundary test depends on which amount is compared.

test_cases.title: Free shipping above the threshold
steps: Put items for 76 USD in the cart
test_cases.basis_quote: Orders over $75 get free standard shipping
